cache_policy.uncached: complete response cache cleared before every run
cache_policy.response_hit: repeated identical request; operational evidence only

host.label: Apple M2 Max; 12 logical CPUs; 32 GiB RAM
host.caveat: Wide final-confirmation distribution retained under high same-host load; do not replace it with the best isolated result.

system-boundary.title: Benchmark boundary: what the timing includes
system-boundary.description: The timed complete request includes service planning and four native multiplier searches; preload and response-cache hits remain outside the uncached-search claim.

autoresearch-loop.title: Bounded autoresearch loop
autoresearch-loop.description: An immutable cache-empty baseline is followed by one-hypothesis candidates, semantic-oracle checks, measured acceptance, rollback of rejects, and a fixed experiment cap.

experiment-outcomes.title: Measured experiment outcomes
experiment-outcomes.description: Candidate medians are shown as measured values; warm-up deadline timeouts are categorical and are not plotted as 120-second successes.

latency-distributions.title: Latency evidence, kept in its measurement context
latency-distributions.description: Three cache-empty distributions and one operational response-cache hit are separated; the 20-second research target is shown without conflating cache hits with search improvements.

profile-bottlenecks.title: Observed bottleneck attribution
profile-bottlenecks.description: Sampling attributed most request samples to native compact search, with heap pop accounting for over half of total samples; these are observed sample shares, not a complete additive decomposition.

two-worker-execution.title: Retained bounded two-worker execution
two-worker-execution.description: Four independent native multiplier searches run at most two at a time, propagate request context, join on success or failure, and restore the original multiplier order.

production_context.policy_caveat: Historical evidence predates the avoid-highways detour-policy correction; current fixed-denominator revalidation remains open.
